title: Coin Hop
hook: A side-on scramble: jump the ledges and grab more coins than your friends.
prompt: a 2D side-on platformer coin grab with friends, pixel art

controls.jump: jump (hold Down on a ledge to drop through)

round.winBy: most coins when the time runs out

rules.summary: Run and jump into a coin to take it. Each coin is a point and comes back a few seconds later. Most coins when the time runs out wins.

characters.describe: a round kid in a cap, seen from the side

slots.describe: a shiny gold coin, one picture

build.what: coins to grab, gone for everyone when one player takes one
build.how: rules.js owns the coins in ctx.shared and gives the points; project/main.gd draws them from the map's coin marks and reports a touch with GF.event
build.accept: a coin you touch disappears on both screens and your score goes up by one

accept: friends see each other on the stage
you can jump up through a ledge and stand on it
a coin taken by one player is gone for everyone
the coin, the kid and every tile are pictures that can be replaced
